observation.visible_scene: Overhead close-up of a dark blue/black bowl filled with water and several ice cubes (a vertical oval piece at left, a rounded piece in the centre, a diagonal piece at right, a small pointed piece near the right rim, and a squarish piece at the bottom). The bowl rests on a reflective surface; a white vertical strip and a green background region are fixed at the right edge of the frame.
visible_changes: The bowl and every ice cube keep the same positions and orientations from the first to the last sampled frame; no translation, rotation, contact, or disappearance is observable.
The camera framing and the background elements (white strip, green area) remain fixed, so no camera motion is detected.

Only subtle, non-directional shimmering of specular highlights on the water surface and on the ice is visible, including a faint transient circular highlight near the centre of the clip; this reflects light/surface variation rather than movement of the ice cubes.
The excerpt is effectively a static shot of floating ice.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the ice is melting, the water is being agitated, or any disturbance occurs before or after this cropped segment.
The temperature or contents of the liquid beyond what is visible.
uncertain_details: The faint circular highlight near the central ice could be a bubble, a reflection, or a compression artifact rather than a physical change.
The exact orientation/shape of the small ice piece at the right rim is hard to track frame-to-frame due to low contrast.
